title: 📱 Nothing OS 4.0 reaches Nothing phones — Android 16 and a deeper dark mode!
body: 📱 Nothing OS 4.0 reaches Nothing phones — Android 16 and a deeper dark mode!
Nothing has begun rolling out the Nothing OS 4.0 update gradually. It is built on Android 16 and reaches the Nothing Phone 3 first, later coming to CMF phones.
The update brings redesigned interface elements, AI-powered features, and smoother app open and close animations.
Among the highlights is the "Extra Dark" mode, which reduces power consumption and extends battery life slightly.
The update arrives in waves, meaning some users will receive it before others — normal for major phone updates.
Simply put: a major update for Nothing phones that combines the new Android system, a cleaner design and a deeper dark mode. If your phone is a Nothing, check for updates in the settings.
